Name: Valley Bond
Author: Alex3108
Description:
[b]Did I use AI? Yes. [/b]
[b]Are there similar mods already available? Yes. [/b]
[b]I wanted to support NPCs from mods, have some kind of gacha with random rewards, and be able to implement 18+ mods as well. So I made this mod and added it to my mod collection. [/b]

[b]I just thought I'd share it with you. If you find any errors, let me know and I'll try to fix them. If you have any ideas for improvements or similar mods, let me know and we can try implementing them. I'd also like to see another mod related to anime or 18+ content, but I haven't been able to come up with anything simple yet. [/b]

Also, please let me know about balance. I assume you can max out the game in the first month and it won't be fun. Please post a balance suggestion.

[b]The interface might be a bit choppy at different screen resolutions. But it shouldn't be anything critical. [/b]

[b]Description[/b]
Valley Bonds is a social quest and relationship progression mod for Stardew Valley.

The mod adds a new layer of daily and weekly social requests, trust progression, ticket rewards, upgrade paths, and optional private bond tracking. Instead of only completing standard board quests, you gradually build a sense of community by helping villagers and supported modded NPCs with small favors, deliveries, visits, conversations, and longer chain tasks.

The goal of Valley Bonds is to make the valley feel more connected. NPCs can ask for favors in their own style, send thank-you letters, reward the player with tickets, and contribute to a shared Valley Trust level. As trust grows, the player unlocks better requests, better rewards, rerolls, perks, and stronger long-term progression.

Valley Bonds is designed to work safely with both vanilla Stardew Valley and large modded setups. If a supported NPC/content mod is not installed, its related content is simply ignored.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Valley Bonds.
3. Extract the ValleyBonds folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
5. Open the Valley Bonds menu in-game with F3.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Daily social requests
Each day, Valley Bonds can generate a new social request. These may involve talking to an NPC, bringing an item, visiting a location, returning to the requester, or completing a small chain of steps.

Weekly requests
Weekly requests are larger tasks with better rewards. They are designed to feel more meaningful than daily favors without replacing the normal Stardew Valley gameplay loop.

Valley Trust progression
Completing requests increases Valley Trust. Higher trust levels unlock better request tiers, more valuable rewards, and additional progression options.

Ticket rewards
Requests can reward gratitude tickets. Tickets are divided into multiple tiers and can be opened through the Valley Bonds menu for randomized rewards.

Upgrade paths
Spend influence points on permanent upgrade paths. These paths improve different parts of the mod, such as friendship rewards, ticket value, or reward upgrade chances.

NPC personality support
Many vanilla and supported modded NPCs have custom request openers and thank-you letters to make their requests feel more personal.

Gift taste requests
Some requests can use NPC gift taste data. The mod avoids asking for extremely rare or story-sensitive gifts too often.

Private Bonds
An optional Private Bonds module tracks a separate private progression level based on supported private event content. It is disabled or limited by config options and is designed to be optional.

Custom menu
Valley Bonds includes its own in-game menu with tabs for requests, tickets, trust, perks, private bonds, and statistics. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required:
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4+[/color]
